reason: A discrete ray-depth surrogate can reproduce lattice-phase aliasing inside the training loss itself unless its depth spacing is tied to a subject-free minimum feature scale.
Log-sum-exp soft-min introduces a multiplicity-dependent O(tau*log(N)) signed bias exactly where tangent silhouette rays create many near-minimum samples.
Area-averaged BCE/Dice can make a small connected source component almost irrelevant even though Stage13 component recall treats its survival as consequential.

depth_sampling_contract.why: Independent bin jitter can create an inter-sample gap approaching twice the nominal bin width. A single global phase shift changes lattice phase without relaxing the maximum spacing bound.

ray_occupancy_contract.reason: torch.amin is differentiable almost everywhere and removes sample-multiplicity bias; phase jitter moves the winning sample across optimization steps.

component_balance_contract.reason: Equal group means give a tiny component consequential gradient without unbounded per-pixel inverse-area weights.

loss_specific_subject_free_gate.reason: Known VF11 R512 SMALL_COMPONENT and THIN_STRAP failures include a separate extraction/phase owner; requiring their downstream MC Stage13 profile to close before evaluating the training surrogate would conflate two independent mechanisms.
required: phase bank does not systematically miss the minimum-width control
finite nonzero gradient exists on foreground and boundary failure cases
small-component loss authority remains consequential under a large-body distractor
FORK_GAP and CONCAVE_NOTCH negative space is not filled merely to improve silhouette occupancy
source-external occupancy pressure and source-interior occupancy pressure both have the expected gradient sign
